cands.name: Peggy Gossett-Seidman
cands.bio: Republican incumbent, in the House since 2022. Former sports journalist, WTA press director and public relations professional; Highland Beach Town Commission 2018-2022; Michigan State graduate.

record.text: Secured a record $19.18 million in state appropriations for HD 91 projects in 2025, including $10 million for an FAU health sciences facility.
2024 bills include CS/HB 117 (release of 2006 Epstein grand jury testimony) and CS/CS/HB 913 (2025, condo and HOA governance).

money_notes.text: Q1 2026 report: biggest single gift $5,000 from the Seminole Tribe of Florida; $2,500 from lobbying firm The Spritz Group; $2,000 each from EarnIn, JM Family Enterprises and Slide Insurance; $1,000 each from three firefighter PACs and Chevron. Also raises through her committee Peggy for the People.

cands.gaps: Oct 2026: she was the target of a threat (a man was arrested); not a controversy about her. Owner-source search was NOT run: web search budget exhausted.

votes.what: Joint resolution putting Amendment 3 (Save Our Homes property-tax changes: higher homestead exemption, lower assessment-increase limits) on the Nov 2026 ballot.
The 2025-26 General Appropriations Act (state budget), final vote.
Immigration enforcement bill from the 2025 special session: state cooperation with federal immigration enforcement.
Post-hurricane emergency management bill that also limits local governments' ability to adopt stricter development rules after storms.
Online Protections for Minors: restricts social media accounts for minors.
Interests of foreign countries: restricts land purchases near military sites and critical infrastructure by people from China and other 'countries of concern'.
Education: expands school voucher eligibility to all Florida K-12 students.
Heartbeat Protection Act: bans most abortions after six weeks of pregnancy.
Public Safety: lets most adults carry a concealed firearm without a permit (permitless carry).
Property Insurance: creates the Florida Optional Reinsurance Assistance program (FORA) for insurers.

record.text: No prior elected office. His site lists volunteer leadership roles including an ICE Watch legal observer team and No Kings protest emergency response coordinator.
